biggest_catch: Coinbase officially discontinued Coinbase Learning rewards on May 27, 2025 — the 'earn $3-10+ per module' program in the catalog no longer exists. Anyone signing up today will not find it, and the signup bonus is unpublished ('varies'), so there is no concrete claim to verify.
catches: Coinbase Learning rewards are no longer available as of May 27, 2025 (official help center).
No published signup bonus amount — 'varies' is not a concrete claim.

Current new-user incentives are separate programs: a US-only 'Buy $50, get random $10-$2,000 in Bitcoin' incentive (99% get $10-$100), a $5 BTC new-customer promo-code offer for new US residents, and a spin-the-wheel first-buy incentive — all randomized or code-gated, none of them the claimed Earn program.
Coinbase's own terms warn crypto rewards 'may increase or decrease in value after it's deposited into your account.'

c1.evidence: Provider is real: coinbase.com / help.coinbase.com official domains.

c2.evidence: Official terms page exists (help.coinbase.com learning-rewards FAQ) but states the program is discontinued — it does not support the claimed $3-10+/module payout.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee involved, but irrelevant since the claimed program no longer exists.

c4.evidence: FAIL: Coinbase's official help page states 'Coinbase Learning rewards are no longer available as of May 27, 2025.' The catalog's '$3-10+ per completed learning module' claim is dead; the signup bonus is unpublished ('varies' = no concrete claim).

eligibility: Earn program: none — discontinued. Current new-user incentives (US-only, new users, first purchase requirements) have their own terms on the official 'New user incentive' help page.
notes: Checked 2026-09-22 (CDT; page fetched live from help.coinbase.com). The catalog claim 'Coinbase Earn $3-10+ per completed learning module (paid in crypto)' was true in 2021-2024 but is now false: the official Learning rewards FAQ page states verbatim 'Coinbase Learning rewards are no longer available as of May 27, 2025. To earn more crypto, try staking your assets.' Per the verification rules, 'signup bonus varies = no concrete claim,' so the signup-bonus half of the claim also fails. For catalog hygiene, note the separate current official new-user incentives on help.coinbase.com/en/coinbase/getting-started/getting-started-with-coinbase/new-customer-incentive (Buy-$50-first-purchase random $10-$2,000 BTC, US-only; $5 BTC new-customer promo code; spin-the-wheel) — these are randomized/code-gated and are NOT the claimed Earn program. No affiliate/review pages were used as evidence.
